gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (trimmed p4, printed p8) prints General Fund, Street Fund and Keno Fund columns; none has a schedule of its own (the p8 budget schedule is all funds combined with the utilities and is not in detail). Only the Property taxes row is in detail (Schedule of County Treasurer Activity p13, indices 0-7, 211,642 = General 193,943 + Street 17,699), so it is not added again. Added every other non-zero revenue cell of the three fund columns exactly as printed on p4. The General Fund 'Sales and other taxes' cell is added as the single printed cell 118,219 (pass 1 split it into the all-funds budget figures Sales tax 111,444 / Other state receipts 6,775 from p8 under the parent label; held for the label); category 'taxes' since the row mixes sales tax and other receipts. General: 118,219 + 24,904 + 163,280 + 52,519 + 202,696 + 7,334 + 15,435 = 584,387 (= 778,330 - 193,943); Street: 28,235 + 12,387 + 176,226 + 1,495 + 3,599 = 221,942 (= 239,641 - 17,699); Keno: 178,883. Added 985,212; 211,642 + 985,212 = 1,196,854 = statement total revenues.
